The battery trigger runs the shortcut once each time the charge falls below the level (checked every minute, check_triggers springboard/apps/shortcuts-desktop/src/widget.rs:1275); the app-open trigger is stored but nothing tells the app when another app opens, so it does not fire yet. Not yet checked on the lab machine.
